items.headline: Stocks Climb Amid Tame Inflation and Strong AI Earnings
items.summary: U.S. equities are advancing today, bolstered by a milder-than-expected July Consumer Price Index report and robust earnings from key artificial intelligence and cloud infrastructure companies. This has spurred positive market sentiment, with major indices showing gains in early trading.

items.statContext: Jumped in early trading, outperforming peers.

items.headline: Nebius Group Surges on Revenue Explosion
items.summary: Shares of AI infrastructure firm Nebius Group ($NBIS) soared 20.5% in morning trading after reporting a massive 454% year-over-year surge in second-quarter revenue to $582 million.

items.headline: CoreWeave Skyrockets on Strong Earnings
items.summary: Cloud computing company CoreWeave ($CRWV) skyrocketed 21% after delivering strong second-quarter earnings that beat expectations and providing an upbeat third-quarter sales forecast.

items.headline: Super Micro Computer Jumps on Earnings Beat
items.summary: Super Micro Computer ($SMCI) surged 14.2% after reporting fourth-quarter earnings per share that came in 84% above analysts' estimates and issuing upbeat guidance for upcoming quarters.

items.headline: Performance Food Group Misses Forecasts
items.summary: Performance Food Group ($PFGC) lost 4.5% after the food service distributor missed fourth-quarter forecasts.

items.headline: US Antimony Corp. Cuts Outlook
items.summary: US Antimony Corp. ($UAMY) fell 16% after the miner and precious metals refiner cut its full-year outlook for gross revenue.

items.headline: Magnificent Seven ETF Slides in Afternoon Trading
items.summary: The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF ($MAGS) sank 1.13% in early afternoon trading, reflecting a broader sell-off in some megacap platform names in what appears to be a rotation day.

items.headline: July CPI Rises as Expected, Easing Fed Hike Concerns
items.summary: The July Consumer Price Index (CPI) increased 0.1% on a seasonally adjusted basis, matching expectations, while core CPI rose 0.2%. The annual inflation rate was 3.4%. This tame inflation data is seen as nudging the Federal Reserve towards holding interest rates steady at their next meeting in September.

items.headline: Federal Reserve Maintains Rates, Simplifies Communication
items.summary: The Federal Reserve has opted to maintain the federal funds rate at 5-5.25%, with discussions indicating a potential increase by year-end. Under Chairman Kevin Warsh, the U.S. central bank has adopted a simpler communications strategy, moving away from explicit forward guidance.

items.headline: Sector Rotation Evident as AI Tech Leads, Consumer Discretionary Lags
items.summary: A broadening market rotation is taking place, with AI-related technology stocks leading the charge following strong earnings. Conversely, sectors like Communication Services and Consumer Discretionary are lagging, with the latter being one of only two sectors in the red for the year, pressured by inflation and hawkish Fed risks.

items.headline: Oil Prices Fluctuate Amid Middle East Tensions
items.summary: Oil prices have seen volatility, rising due to recent ship attacks and an impasse in US-Iran talks, which reinforces worries about disruptions to Middle East supplies. The International Energy Agency (IEA) has also warned of rapidly depleting oil stockpiles and urged a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

items.headline: Housing Industry Faces Headwinds from High Mortgage Rates
items.summary: The housing industry is experiencing difficulties as higher Treasury yields have pushed long-term mortgage rates to their highest level in a year, impacting homebuilders. Builders FirstSource, D.R. Horton, and Lennar all saw declines today.
